text: Claimed P4 after requirement and authority-boundary audit. Planned ownership: core durable output/result/task contracts; protocol canonical language-neutral worker events and result envelopes; new worker module registry, IO runtime, managed/native task contexts, atomic result publication; managed schema and epoch-fenced result acceptance/reattachment; Python and R reference producers under examples. No closure, Future, arbitrary JVM graph, or IO value serialization.
